import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Step implements Comparable<Step> {
        long value;
        int cost;

        Step(long value, int cost) {
            this.value = value;
            this.cost = cost;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Step other) {
            // PriorityQueue in Java is a min-heap, so to mimic the C++ code's behavior,
            // we need to invert the comparison to get the same ordering.
            return Integer.compare(other.cost, this.cost);
        }
    }

    static Set<Long> visitedSet = new HashSet<>();

    static boolean checkVisited(long c) {
        return visitedSet.contains(c);
    }

    static Step findUupper(long n) {
        long res = 0;
        int count = 0;
        while (res < n) {
            res = res * 10 + 1;
            count++;
        }
        return new Step(res, count);
    }

    static Step findUpperBound(long n) {
        long res = 0;
        int count = 0;
        while (res * 10 + 1 <= n) {
            res = res * 10 + 1;
            count++;
        }
        long baseRes = res;
        int baseCount = count;
        while (res < n) {
            res += baseRes;
            count += baseCount;
        }
        return new Step(res, count);
    }

    static Step findLowerBound(long n) {
        long res = 0;
        int count = 0;
        while (res * 10 + 1 <= n) {
            res = res * 10 + 1;
            count++;
        }
        long baseRes = res;
        int baseCount = count;
        while (res + baseRes <= n) {
            res += baseRes;
            count += baseCount;
        }
        return new Step(res, count);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());

        PriorityQueue<Step> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
        pq.add(new Step(n, 0));

        while (pq.peek().value != 0) {
            Step current = pq.poll();
            long val = current.value;
            int cst = current.cost;

            if (checkVisited(val))
                continue;
            visitedSet.add(val);

            for (Step s : Arrays.asList(findLowerBound(val), findUpperBound(val), findUupper(val))) {
                s.cost += cst;
                s.value = Math.abs(val - s.value);
                pq.add(s);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(pq.peek().cost);
    }
}
